summary: Iteration_10 — Retest of 3 frontend fixes from iteration_9 for the Referrals module (vendor side). All 3 fixes verified PASS via Playwright against the public preview URL. No backend tests run (per request: backend was 17/17 in iter_9, no backend changes since).

fix1_signup_banner_business_name.valid_ref_shows_business_name: PASS — /signup?ref=acme-dental-clinic-60afb5 → signup-ref-banner appeared after backend resolve completed, text = 'Referred by Acme Dental Clinic' (NOT the raw code).
fix1_signup_banner_business_name.invalid_ref_shows_no_banner: PASS — /signup?ref=totally-bogus-xyz → no signup-ref-banner element in DOM after resolve (waited 2.5s for the API to respond).

fix2_referral_redirect_validates.valid_code_redirects_with_ref: PASS — /r/acme-dental-clinic-60afb5 → redirected to /signup?ref=acme-dental-clinic-60afb5 and banner shows 'Acme Dental Clinic'.
fix2_referral_redirect_validates.invalid_code_redirects_clean: PASS — /r/totally-bogus-xyz → redirected to /signup (no ref= query param) and no signup-ref-banner.

fix3_sidebar_clickable_under_paywall.paywall_overlay_on_app: PASS — accounts@thedigisparrow.com logged in, /app shows paywall-overlay.
fix3_sidebar_clickable_under_paywall.z_index_layering: PASS — computed styles: vendor-sidebar position=relative z-index=60, paywall-overlay z-index=50 (sidebar sits ABOVE overlay).
fix3_sidebar_clickable_under_paywall.nav_referrals_clickable: PASS — non-force click on data-testid='nav-referrals' worked (overlay does not intercept).
fix3_sidebar_clickable_under_paywall.overlay_hidden_on_referrals: PASS — paywall-overlay not present on /app/referrals (PaywallGuard bypasses /app/referrals path).
fix3_sidebar_clickable_under_paywall.referrals_page_renders: PASS — data-testid='referrals-page' rendered, referral link visible (immipro-6c306f), tabs (Overview, My Referrals, Commissions, Payouts, Bank Account) all visible.

critical_code_review_comments: Signup.jsx resolve guard correctly gates banner on (refCode && refBiz) — both are set only after a successful backend confirmation. Good defensive pattern.

ReferralRedirect.jsx network-failure branch still pushes ref=<code> into URL and localStorage even when validity cannot be confirmed. Signup re-validates so banner won't appear, but the ?ref= param remains attached and will be sent on signup submit as referral_code. Backend must reject unknown codes (it already does — see /api/referrals/public/resolve returning valid:false), but worth confirming the signup endpoint also tolerates an unknown referral_code without 500. Non-blocking; informational.
PaywallGuard correctly whitelists /app/billing and /app/referrals via startsWith — good.
VendorLayout aside z-[60] with position:relative is sufficient because the overlay is position:fixed z-50 — verified via getComputedStyle in the live page.
test_credentials: Used demo@botnira.com / demo123 (referrer) and accounts@thedigisparrow.com / TestExpiredTrial!1 (paywalled). Both authenticated successfully against the live API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 referral-module frontend fixes from iter_9 are confirmed working. Note that POST /api/auth/login returns the JWT under the key 'token' (not 'access_token') — important for any future pytest fixture. The Payouts empty-state issue noted in iter_9 is by-design (only renders when Payouts tab is active) and was not retested. No further action needed on the referrals module.
